S1.message: What's the difference between the Get Clássica and the Get Smart?
S1.answer:
- **Focus:** Get Clássica is for faster payments and receipt printing. Get Smart is for fuller management, with order-to-payment integration (https://www.santander.com.br/blog/seus-negocios/solucoes-getnet/).
- **Rental:** Get Clássica is free at R$ 10,000/month in sales per machine, otherwise R$ 79.90/month. Get Smart is free at R$ 60,000/month per machine, otherwise R$ 129.90/month (https://site.getnet.com.br/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/termos_e_condicoes_aluguel.pdf).
- **Connectivity:** Get Clássica has a 3G chip, Wi-Fi and a receipt printer roll. Get Smart has a 3G chip with a free data plan and Wi-Fi (https://www.santander.com.br/blog/seus-negocios/solucoes-getnet/).
- **Both:** Both accept tap payments and Pix via QR Code (https://www.santander.com.br/blog/seus-negocios/solucoes-getnet/).

S4.message: Do I need a bank account to receive my sales via Pix?
S4.answer:
Yes, at least for Get Tap. To sell with Pix, you must enable the feature and link a bank account in the Getnet Brasil app. The linked account is the one that receives the Pix payments.

Steps: Services → "Venda com Pix" → Habilitar → choose your bank and follow the on-screen instructions.

Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/pix-no-get-tap-mais-agilidade-e-eficiencia-das-vendas/

S6.message: How does receivables advance (antecipação) work with Getnet?
S6.answer:
Receivables advance (antecipação) lets you receive credit card sales (lump-sum or installment) before the original scheduled date, in exchange for a fee. It is not a loan: no new debt is created, you simply get money that is already yours earlier. Eligible credit sales can be advanced under your contracted solution.

You can check available receivables, simulate the advance and see the net amount before confirming in the Getnet Brasil app. On the Get Smart terminal: Payment > Antecipação > enter the merchant password > select the card brand > Antecipar > enter the advance code from the consultation, then a receipt is printed.

Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/quando-vale-a-pena-antecipar-as-suas-vendas-no-cartao/ and https://site.getnet.com.br/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/Manul-GetSmart.pdf

S9.message: How many installments can I split a sale into with the crediário?
S9.answer:
Up to 48 installments. Note that the maximum number of installments and the contracting fees depend on your customer's issuing bank. The folder indicates that some banks offer up to 24x, and Santander offers up to 48x (subject to change). The customer also needs enough available credit card limit to cover the full purchase amount.
Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/Folder_Credirio.pdf

S10.message: Can I sell through WhatsApp using the Payment Link?
S10.answer:
Yes. Getnet's Payment Link lets you create a link and send it through WhatsApp, social networks, email, or any other digital channel. You don't need a card machine or an online store. The customer clicks the link and pays by credit card, debit card, or Pix.

Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/link-de-pagamento-getnet/ (also https://site.getnet.com.br/link-de-pagamento-vendas/)
